children: President and Chief Operating Officer Gwynne Shotwell filed to sell 342,170 shares of the space and satellite company, with the proposed transaction valued at nearly $52 million.

The Form 144 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday lists an aggregate market value of $51.96 million for the shares, implying a value of about $151.85 apiece. Morgan Stanley Smith Barney is listed as the broker, and the filing gives Sept. 22 as the approximate date of sale on Nasdaq.
Shotwell acquired the 342,170 common shares on Sept. 22 through the exercise of stock options, according to the filing. The form lists the payment method as cash.
The filing is notable for investors following insider activity at SpaceX

following its June initial public offering. Shotwell is both an officer and director of the company. The proposed sale represents only a small fraction of the roughly 7.70 billion shares listed as outstanding in the filing.

The filing indicates that the transaction is being made under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted on June 23. Such plans allow corporate insiders to establish instructions for future stock transactions in advance, subject to applicable securities rules.
The filing also states that Shotwell had no securities sales to report during the preceding three months.
identified Shotwell as the person for whose account the securities are to be sold. The Form 144, which provides notice of a proposed sale under Rule 144 of the Securities Act, was filed Sept. 22.
